metadata.name: zap
metadata.description: ZAP Protocol: oracle-priced perpetual futures on Solana

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: Pays the account rent (the relayer, so users never need SOL); refunded when the account closes.

instructions.name: execute_trigger
docs: Permissionless: executes a triggered order (`target` 0, `id` = order id) or a position's take-profit (1) or
stop-loss (2) (`id` = position id).

accounts.name: executor
docs: Anyone (in practice, the keeper). Pays only the transaction fee.

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Permissionless liquidation at the signed oracle price.

accounts.name: liquidator_account
docs: The liquidator's own trading account, credited with the liquidation reward.

instructions.name: refresh_markets
docs: `price_msg` must stay the first argument: the ed25519 check expects it at a fixed offset.

errors.name: Unauthorized

errors.name: SessionExpired

errors.name: InvalidSessionExpiry

fields.name: delta
docs: Positive: added from the balance; negative: removed to the balance.

fields.name: borrow_paid
docs: Borrow fee and funding settled from the collateral first (funding: positive = paid, negative = received).

types.name: Config
docs: Protocol-wide settings. Changed only by the admin.

fields.name: pyth_storage
docs: Pyth Pro storage account listing trusted signers (used when `use_pyth_storage`).

fields.name: oracle_signers
docs: Additional trusted price signers with their expiry (unix seconds); unused slots are the default key.

fields.name: required_channel
docs: Accepted Pyth Pro channel (3 = fixed rate 200ms).

fields.name: max_price_age_s
docs: Oldest accepted message timestamp, seconds.

fields.name: max_future_s
docs: Furthest accepted message timestamp ahead of the cluster clock, seconds.

fields.name: max_feed_age_s
docs: Oldest accepted feed update (guards against carried-forward prices), seconds.

fields.name: price_grace_ms
docs: How far behind a market's latest used price a new price may be, milliseconds.

fields.name: max_util_bps
docs: Reserved liquidity / vault assets cap for new risk.

fields.name: protocol_fee_share_bps
docs: Share of trading and borrow fees kept by the protocol; the rest goes to LPs.

fields.name: funding_max_hourly
docs: Funding rate at full imbalance, per hour (1e18 = 100%).

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new risk (opens, order placement) only; closes, liquidations and withdrawals always work.

fields.name: bad_debt
docs: Loss beyond the position's collateral, absorbed by the vault.

types.name: Market
docs: One perpetual market: parameters, per-side open interest aggregates, funding indices and the price watermark.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Pyth Pro feed id.

fields.name: expo
docs: Pyth exponent of the feed; fixed at listing.

fields.name: oi_long
docs: Σ size (entry notional, USD 6 decimals) per side.

fields.name: units_long
docs: Σ units (12 decimals) per side: gives the traders' aggregate PnL in O(1).

fields.name: funding_index_long
docs: Cumulative funding owed per unit of size (1e18 = 100%); long grows and short shrinks when longs pay.

fields.name: sum_sf_long
docs: Σ size · funding index at each position's last settlement, per side (unscaled).

fields.name: funding_rate
docs: Current funding rate per second (1e18 = 100%), recomputed after every open-interest change.

fields.name: last_price
docs: Latest accepted oracle price (12 decimals) and confidence, and its publish time: the watermark new prices
must not fall behind (minus the configured grace).

types.name: MarketParams
docs: Risk and fee parameters of a market. Changeable by the admin without touching open positions' entries.
Stored inside the zero-copy `Market` and also passed as an instruction argument, hence both Pod and Borsh.

fields.name: conf_mult_bps
docs: Half-spread from the Pyth confidence interval, as a multiple (1e4 = 1.0×).

fields.name: max_conf_bps
docs: New risk is refused while confidence / price exceeds this.

fields.name: oi_cap_long_bps
docs: Open interest caps per side, as a share of vault assets.

fields.name: min_spread_frac
docs: Minimum half-spread (1e12 = 100%, so 1bp = 1e8).

fields.name: impact_depth_usd
docs: Price-impact depth in USD (6 decimals): larger means less impact.

fields.name: max_position_usd
docs: Largest single position (USD, 6 decimals).

types.name: Order
docs: A resting order: opening limit/stop orders escrow their margin and fee; take-profit and stop-loss orders reduce a
position (possibly partially, which gives multi-level take-profits).

fields.name: position_id
docs: Position this order reduces (0 for opening orders).

fields.name: size_usd
docs: Size to open or close (USD entry notional); u64::MAX closes the whole position.

fields.name: acceptable_price
docs: Worst acceptable fill price (0 = none).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix seconds; the executing price must be published after this.

fields.name: tp_price
docs: Take-profit / stop-loss to attach to the position when an opening order fills (0 = none).

types.name: Pool
docs: The LP vault: realized assets, reserved liquidity, LP share supply, and the pool-wide borrow index.
Also the authority of the custody token account that holds all USDC.

fields.name: assets
docs: LP-owned USDC after realized trader PnL and fees (6 decimals).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Σ open position sizes: each position reserves its maximum payout.

fields.name: protocol_fees
docs: Protocol's share of fees, withdrawable by the admin.

fields.name: borrow_index
docs: Cumulative borrow index (1e18 = 100%).

fields.name: sum_size_borrow_entry
docs: Σ size · borrow index at each position's last settlement (unscaled).

fields.name: seq
docs: Increments on every event, so indexers can detect gaps.

types.name: Position
docs: An open position (isolated margin). Hedge mode: a market can hold one long and one short at the same time.

fields.name: size_usd
docs: Entry notional (USD, 6 decimals).

fields.name: units
docs: Base-asset units (12 decimals).

fields.name: entry_funding_index
docs: Indices at the last settlement; accrued funding and borrow are settled into collateral on every change.

fields.name: last_price_ts_us
docs: Publish time of the last price used; later prices for this position may not be older.

fields.name: tp_price
docs: Take-profit and stop-loss trigger prices (12 decimals), 0 when unset.

types.name: Trade
docs: Every fill. USD amounts have 6 decimals; prices 12.

fields.name: size_delta
docs: Entry notional opened (positive) or closed (negative).

fields.name: funding_paid
docs: Positive: paid by the trader; negative: received.

fields.name: payout
docs: Credited to the trader's balance.

types.name: TradingAccount
docs: A trader's account: USDC balance, LP shares, session key, and inline position and order slots.
One account per owner wallet. Rent is paid by the relayer and refunded to it when the account closes.

fields.name: session_key
docs: Signs trades without the owner (no wallet pop-ups). Cannot withdraw or change the session.

fields.name: balance
docs: Free USDC (6 decimals), not backing any position or order.

fields.name: lp_cost_basis
docs: USDC paid for the LP shares still held, for LP PnL.
